info.title: Visual Diagram Gen API
info.description: Backend API for the AI explainer animation tool. This document describes the public HTTP contract used by the frontend and MCP tooling.

clientKey.description: Optional idempotency key; repeat requests with the same key return the in-flight render instead of creating a duplicate.

selection.description: Optional editor selection supplied as context.

AIOperation.description: Deterministic, addressable scene operation. Supported types: createInstance, updateInstance, deleteInstance, createGroup, deleteGroup, moveInstance, resizeInstance, updateProps, updateStyle, setVisibility, setZIndex, setReference, addAnimationTrack, addKeyframe, deleteKeyframe. New instances are addressed by clientKey within the plan.

AIPlan.description: Structured AI intent. Temporary planning data, not a second document model; applying it goes through the existing domain mutations.

applied.description: Operations in applied order, with the concrete ids they produced.

post.description: Legacy/deprecated path: renders the project's VideoSpec. Prefer POST /scenes/{id}/renders (SceneDocument rendering = current production path). This endpoint still works and returns Deprecation: true.

Get lean render status for polling

post.summary: Cancel a queued or in-progress render
Create a scene in a project

get.summary: List recent renders for a scene

post.summary: Enqueue a production SceneDocument render (current production path)
post.description: SceneDocument rendering = current production path. VideoSpec rendering via POST /projects/{id}/renders = legacy/deprecated path.

422.description: Scene references an unknown component definition

post.summary: Generate a validated AI scene edit plan (planning only, never mutates)
post.description: Builds selective scene context (document, authorized component definitions, timeline), sends it to the configured OpenRouter model, and validates the structured response against the AI plan schema. The plan is returned for inspection. AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (503) when no API key is configured; AI_PROVIDER_ERROR / AI_INVALID_RESPONSE / AI_SCHEMA_ERROR (502) when the model fails or returns invalid output.

502.description: AI provider, response, or schema error

post.summary: Apply a previously validated AI plan through the existing domain mutations
post.description: Re-validates the complete plan against a fresh SceneDocument snapshot before any write, then applies each operation sequentially through the existing document service. An invalid plan applies nothing (AI_OPERATION_INVALID, 422). Component authorization and reference validation remain enforced.

200.description: Plan applied; returns the updated SceneDocument

get.summary: Get a scene document (scene with component instances and groups)

post.summary: Create a component instance in a scene (props validated against the definition schema)

Add a component instance to a group (same scene required)

delete.summary: Remove a component instance from its group
